verdict.rationale: Rive documents official open-source runtime libraries for loading and controlling animations in apps, games, and websites, backed by the rive-runtime GitHub repo. Web runtime API docs cover caching and data-binding calls, and community comments corroborate the MIT-licensed runtime and engine integration. missing for 10: an explicit per-platform SDK list with API reference depth beyond the web runtime, and evidence of SDK ergonomics aimed at AI or agent consumers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Rive runtimes are open-source libraries that allow you to load and control your animations in apps, games, and websites.
You can use the same exported file across supported runtimes, including web, mobile, game engines, and other platforms.
Loads .riv files, advances state machines and animations, and draws via the abstract Renderer interface.
Data binding — autoBind, view models, bindViewModelInstance
this is an MIT license for Rive's rendering abstraction layer, a subset of the Rive runtime
